data.name: Qari
data.gender_notes: Qari is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Qari is a title given to someone who has mastered the art of reciting the Quran with proper pronunciation and intonation. It signifies a person with a deep understanding of Islamic scripture. The name Qari carries the meaning “One who recites Quran” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Qari usually hope their child will grow to embody one who recites quran and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: As mentioned in the Quran, 'Those to whom We have given the Book recite it with its true recital' (Surah Baqarah, 2:121), a Qari is considered to be a guardian of the Quranic message.
data.etymology: Qari belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who recites Quran.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qari total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: قرئي
in_arabic.meaning: معنى هو القراءة أو القارئ أو المقرئ
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم القرئي، يعود إلى الأصل العربي قرأ، والكاف والراء والياء، معناه قارئ القرآن الكريم، أو المقرئ، وهو الشخص الذي يعمل على قراءة القرآن في المساجد والمناسبات الإسلامية، وتسمية الأطفال بأسماء القرآن الكريم هي من العادات في الإسلام، حيث يعتبر القرآن مصدرًا للطهر والبركة، والقرئي من أسماء النبيين والصحابة، ومن الشخصيات الإسلامية المهمة

in_urdu.name: قرئی
in_urdu.meaning: قرئی کا مطلب ہے پڑھنا یا پڑھنے والا یا مقرئ
in_urdu.long_meaning: قرئی نام، قرآن پاک میں سے لیا گیا ہے، قرأ کا مطلب ہے پڑھنا، اور یہ نام قراءت کرنے والے شخص کے لئے ہے، اور یہ نام مسلمانوں کے لئے اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ قرآن پاک مسلمانوں کے لئے ہدایت اور رہنمائی کا ذریعہ ہے، اور قرئی نام نبی اور صحابیوں میں سے ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامی دنیا میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: قرئी
in_hindi.meaning: قرअय का अर्थ है पढ़ना या पढ़ने वाला या मक्री
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम कुरअय, कुरअन पाक से लिया गया है, कुरअय का अर्थ है पढ़ना, और यह नाम पढ़ने वाले व्यक्ति के लिए है, और यह नाम मुस्लिमों के लिए महत्व रखता है, क्योंकि कुरअन पाक मुस्लिमों के लिए हिदायत और राहदारी का स्रोत है, और कुरअय नाम नबी और साहबाओं में से है, और यह नाम इस्लामी दुनिया में महत्व रखता है, और यह नाम मुस्लिम बच्चों के लिए उपयुक्त है

in_english.name: Qari
in_english.meaning: Qari means reader or one who recites the Quran or one who is skilled in reciting the Quran
in_english.long_meaning: The name Qari is derived from the Arabic root Qaraa, which means to read. A Qari is a person who is skilled in reciting the Quran, and the name is given to children in many Muslim cultures around the world. The Quran is considered a source of guidance and blessing in Islam, and the name Qari is associated with piety, wisdom, and spiritual growth. In Islamic tradition, Qaris are revered for their knowledge and skill in reciting the Quran, and the name is considered a blessing for children.

data.cultural_impact: The title "Qari" holds immense cultural significance in the Islamic world. It is a mark of commitment and dedication towards learning and preserving the teachings of the Quran. A Qari is often revered and respected within their community for their mastery over the holy scripture. Their recitation is also a source of inspiration, comfort, and guidance for many Muslims around the world. Furthermore, the widespread practice of hosting Qari's for public recitations, known as Tarawih, during the month of Ramadan, emphasizes the communal nature of Islamic tradition and education.
data.spiritual_significance: The title "Qari" carries profound spiritual significance for Muslims. It embodies the pursuit of knowledge and the deep connection to the sacred texts that are at the core of Islamic faith. A Qari is seen as a guardian and custodian of the Quran, responsible for preserving its accurate transmission through their exceptional recitation and understanding. Their ecclesiastical role is crucial in guiding and educating fellow Muslims, fostering a deeper appreciation and exploration of their faith. Ultimately, the title "Qari" represents a life dedicated to spiritual growth and the dissemination of Islamic knowledge.
